findings.title: Flex layout disables the small-action button's right float
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so its direct `button` child is a flex item and its existing `float: right` declaration (line 309) no longer controls its placement. The button will be laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of at the right edge, regressing the alignment of small-action controls. Add an explicit flex alignment rule such as `margin-left: auto` to the button (and remove reliance on the float).
